targets.query: from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aquaos_measurements_v1" and r._field == "value")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "aquaos_command_outcomes_v1") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count)
